name: Monica Kodwani
shortBio: I am a PhD candidate in Computer Science (usable security and privacy) at The George Washington University. I build human-centered tools and methods for evaluating, auditing, and governing generative AI systems in real-world use, with a focus on privacy reflection, transparency, and accountability.

quickFacts.label: Area
quickFacts.value: Human-centered evaluation and governance of generative AI

quickFacts.label: Methods
quickFacts.value: Interactive audits, user studies, privacy reflection tools, and evaluation infrastructure

quickFacts.label: Systems
quickFacts.value: Audit interfaces, AI interaction history dashboards, and open-source evaluation workflows
